name: Generic Payment Card (Front)
description: Standard ISO/IEC 7810 ID-1 financial transaction payment card (credit/debit/prepaid) front layout per SECURE_GALLERY.md §8.1 and §8.2.

fields.name: Issuing Bank Logo
fields.description: Issuing bank / financial institution branding left visible per §8.1.

fields.name: Card Network Logo
fields.description: Payment network brand mark (Visa, Mastercard, JCB, etc.) in the lower-right left visible per §8.1.

fields.name: Primary Account Number (PAN)
fields.description: 16-digit payment card number band across the center of the card.

fields.name: Expiration Date
fields.description: Card expiration date (VALID THRU MM/YY) located below the card number.

fields.name: Cardholder Name
fields.description: Embossed or printed cardholder full name in the lower-left section.
